documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Jubilant Agri And Consumer Products Limited Has Informed To The Exchange About Update On Capacity Addition.

analysis.summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited presented its Q4 and FY26 financial results, recording consolidated revenue from operations of INR 4,852 million in Q4 FY26 and INR 18,911 million in FY26. Adhesives performance was supported by double-digit revenue growth following GST rate reductions and discretionary spending recovery, though input cost pressures emerged late in the year. Performance polymers and agri nutrients experienced headwinds from global market weakness, raw material inflation in sulphur and acid, and regulatory changes in FCO norms for bio-stimulants. The company announced that its polymer facility at Samlya, Gujarat will commence in Q1 FY27 and noted progress on the demerger of its Agri division. Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited reported Q3 FY26 consolidated revenue from operations of INR 4,510 million and EBITDA of INR 393 million.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved an expansion of Performance Polymers manufacturing capacity at the Samlya site in Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved the expansion of its Performance Polymers (WWA and SBR Latex) manufacturing capacity of the Company by setting up a manufacturing facility at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara site.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed capacity addition for Performance Polymers is 30,000 MTPA.
The required investment for the capacity expansion is approximately INR 50 Crores.
The Board approved a capex of approximately Rs. 50 Crs for new manufacturing facilities in Samlya, Vadodara, Gujarat.
